title: DD Robocon 2026 — Kung Fu Quest
short_description: ABU Robocon 2026 dual-robot system with autonomous navigation and Tic-Tac-Toe strategy AI.
description: ABU Robocon 2026 (Hong Kong) — 'Kung Fu Quest' symbolizes a robotic journey mirroring a disciple's path to mastery. Our dual-robot system must navigate the Martial Club to assemble weapons, traverse the Meihua Forest to collect sacred Kung Fu Scrolls, and engage in a strategic Tic-Tac-Toe showdown. Stage 1 Score: 94/100.

title: Basketball Arena Bot (2024)
short_description: Two-robot system competing on a full-size basketball court with real-time positioning and scoring.
description: Competed in DD Robocon 2024 with a basketball-themed challenge. Two robots executed passes, precise positioning, and basket scoring in real-time on a full-scale arena.

title: AIR 4 Bot — DD Robocon 2015
short_description: SPARK's best-ever national ranking robot — AIR 4 at DD Robocon 2015.
description: The robot that brought SPARK its best-ever All India Rank of 4 at DD Robocon 2015. This milestone remains the gold standard the team chases every year.

title: International Rank 2 Bot (2018)
short_description: Competed internationally at IIT Bombay IRC, achieving International Rank 2.
description: Our 2018 competition robot not only achieved AIR 13 nationally at DD Robocon but also took SPARK global — winning International Rank 2 at the IIT Bombay International Robotics Challenge.

title: Perfect Tech Report Bot (2020)
short_description: AIR 9 robot with a perfect 100/100 Technical Report score at DD Robocon 2020.
description: This robot's technical documentation received a perfect 100/100 score — the benchmark for engineering excellence in Indian robotics. Combined with AIR 9 nationally, it set SPARK's documentation standard.
